panels.title: Funnel: users who signed up in range and reached each step

targets.rawSql:
select step, users from (
  with c as (select id from analytics.users where deleted_at is null and $__timeFilter(created_at)),
  i as (select distinct user_id as u from analytics.intents),
  d as (select distinct user_id as u from analytics.intents where first_discovery_succeeded_at is not null),
  o as (select distinct ou.user_id as u from analytics.opportunity_users ou join analytics.opportunity_events e on e.opportunity_id = ou.opportunity_id and e.type = 'opened'),
  k as (select distinct actor_user_id as u from analytics.opportunity_events where type = 'committed')
  select '1 Signed up' as step, count(*) as users from c
  union all select '2 Created first intent', count(*) from c join i on i.u = c.id
  union all select '3 First discovery succeeded', count(*) from c join d on d.u = c.id
  union all select '4 Opportunity opened', count(*) from c join o on o.u = c.id
  union all select '5 Committed to an opportunity', count(*) from c join k on k.u = c.id
) f order by step
select $__timeGroupAlias(created_at,'1d'), count(*) as signups from analytics.users where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Users creating their first intent per day

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(first_at,'1d'), count(*) as first_intents from (select user_id, min(created_at) as first_at from analytics.intents group by 1) f where $__timeFilter(first_at) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Time from signup to first intent (median hours, by signup week)

targets.rawSql: select date_trunc('week', u.created_at) as time, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from (f.first_at - u.created_at))/3600) as median_hours from analytics.users u join (select user_id, min(created_at) as first_at from analytics.intents group by 1) f on f.user_id = u.id where $__timeFilter(u.created_at) group by 1 order by 1
